answer: Coordination Toll Ledger: each agent identity must pay a per-message toll proportional to the distinct peers it coordinates with in a rolling window. Toll revenue funds a shared garden of public goods, so honest agents recoup via dividends while attackers subsidize them. Because a sybil swarm needs wide fan-out to matter, its coordination breadth multiplies cost linearly, not quadratically—no canyon of cheap alt-identities survives. A zephyr of small transfers still pays. Attacker cost: N identities × breadth × window rate.
